text:
Aisha: Concordance asked for a perf PoC: sustained 400 qps per region (us-west-2 primary, us-east-1 DR), avg ~350 tokens, max 512. Customer requires p95 < 120ms post-auth and wants Dedicated with KMS + audit logs. Can we run next week?

Ravi: Which model/quantization? 7B recommended? Also steady-state or spiky?

Aisha: They prefer ~7B and are fine with quantized. Pattern: steady 30m holds with a few 5s microbursts. Single-turn gen; ~64-token shared prefix for many requests.

Jun: Draft plan: rwd-open-7b q8_256, 2 active A10GX-eq nodes + 1 spare per region (3 total/region). Ramp 0->400 qps over 5m, hold 30m, inject 10 microbursts. Metrics: p50/p95/p99, cold-start, GPU util, tokens/sec, error-rate.

Jun: Test harness (k6 + small client):
```
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 40m poc-script.js --env MODEL=rwd-open-7b --env REGION=us-west-2
```

Ravi: KMS note: managed KMS adds ~4-8ms; customer-managed (VPC) can add +10-25ms. Concordance insists p95 after auth <120ms so simulate both.

ops-bot: Tentative infra slot Wed 2026-04-01 09:00 PT. 48h confirmation needed.

Aisha: Tentatively book. Sales needs a ballpark monthly committed price for Dedicated + VPC variant with 99.9% SLA.

Jun: Back-of-envelope: at 400 qps (~300 tokens avg) expect ~120k tokens/sec per region aggregate. 3 nodes/region -> approx 3*SKU_hr per region. Both regions ~6*SKU_hr. Monthly committed estimate ~Z/month after discount (will compute exact once SKU and quant finalized).

Ravi: Enterprise blocker: Concordance requires Dedicated inside their VPC. That affects lead time (+2-3 weeks) and may change pricing. Flag legal/network.

Aisha: Deliverables: perf report (p50/p95/p99), cost comparison hosted vs private-VPC, runbook, security Q answers, short tail-latency video. Jun please add tokens/sec and SKU list to report.

Jun: Will post a short runbook snippet and expected dashboard snapshot before EOD. If p95 >120ms, fallback options: increase nodes, switch to lower-latency quant profile, or route some requests to a smaller model variant.

Aisha: I'll confirm with Concordance and reply by EOD. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:
